hooks.command: bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+-rf\s+(/|~|\.|\.\.)|git\s+push\s+.*(-f|--force)|DROP\s+TABLE|DROP\s+DATABASE|truncate\s+|:(){ :|:& };:"; then echo "BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected"; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; EXT="${FILE##*.}"; if [[ "$EXT" == "ts" || "$EXT" == "tsx" || "$EXT" == "js" || "$EXT" == "jsx" ]]; then npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0'
